name: web-home-decor-shop-listing-with-serif-tabs-and-acid-yellow-feature
title: Home-decor store: serif category tabs, mixed-size product grid and an acid-yellow artisan feature
whatItIs: On a dusty rose board, a desktop and a mobile view. A centred serif title 'Shop All Home Decor Items', serif tabs (All, Lighting, Furniture, Wall Art), a filter bar, a grid with one tall photo of a dark vase and smaller products with price and material lines and colour chips, and a full-width acid-yellow block 'Artisan Wooden Chair' with a craftsperson photo. The mobile view uses pill tabs and a two-column grid.
whatItMeans: Curated and crafted; serif and earthy photos with one acid-yellow jolt feel like a boutique.
techniques: Use big serif category tabs with an underline.
Make one product photo span two rows.
Add colour chips beside price lines.
Break the grid with an acid-yellow feature block.

vocabulary.definition: A product photo spanning several rows.
A small swatch showing product colour.
A large text label switching product groups.
